title: Meeting a real recluse on the second Athos trip

tellings.quote: I actually met a real recluse the second time I went to Mount Athos and who gave me a book and tremendous conversation we had about the apocalypse.

plain: On his second visit to Mount Athos, a Greek mountain of monasteries, around 2005, Ralph Larson says he met a real hermit who gave him a book. Larson, the guest on a 2026 episode titled after a CIA chief who calls himself a time traveler, tells it himself. He says the two had a tremendous conversation about the end of the world.
